headline: Skubal is a Met at $450 million, and with nine days to the lockout every other ace-hungry team just got its starting gun.

news.title: Skubal agrees with Mets: nine years, $450 million
news.note: A record $50M AAV with a $45M signing bonus and a no-trade clause. It beat Toronto's nine-year, $400M-plus offer; the Dodgers never made one.

news.title: Padres pivot after the Skubal miss
news.note: San Diego has one sure rotation returnee. Michael King is the obvious reunion target, with Peralta, Taira and Pivetta also in play.

news.title: Luis Gil signs with the Tigers
news.note: The 2024 AL Rookie of the Year took one year, $2.3M, a day after the Yankees non-tendered him.

news.title: Padres, Mariners, Phillies check in on Jarren Duran
news.note: That makes four known suitors with the Cubs. Boston tendered him at a projected $11.1M after a 69 wRC+ season.

news.title: Giants want a 'very strong return' for Logan Webb
news.note: Some rival executives doubt San Francisco gets its price. The Giants would rather move Devers, Adames or Chapman.

news.title: Mets extend A.J. Ewing for eight years, $95 million
news.note: A record for a Mets pre-arbitration player, with a $25M club option for a ninth year.
